name: Soapland Story II -Memory-
original_name: ソープランドストーリー Ⅱ -Memory-
source:
City nanpa adventure with more complex mechanics and maintaining such stats as Life, Strength, Experience and Money.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-january-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一款以城市搭訕為主題的冒險遊戲，系統較前作更加複雜，需要管理生命、體力、經驗和金錢等數值。
